doc.name: alalanet — check before your agent installs, connects or pays

annotations.title: Is it safe to open this repository in an agent?

tools.description: Before opening or trusting a GitHub repository someone sent you (a take-home task, a code review, a demo, a fork): its agent configuration can start MCP servers, run hooks and editor tasks, widen permissions and plant instructions as soon as the project is opened. Pass repo (owner/repo or a GitHub URL) and optional ref; for a local or private checkout pass files instead (path -> content of those files; the public record then holds only the decision, the files' sha256 and bare reason codes, the packages they name are checked without being signed, remote servers are looked up but not probed, and only CODEX_HOME, model-API, proxy and preload variables are read from .env). alalanet reads the files agents and editors load (.mcp.json at any depth, .github/mcp.json, .claude/settings.json, .cursor/mcp.json and hooks.json, .vscode/mcp.json, settings.json and tasks.json, .devcontainer, .gemini/settings.json and .env, .zed/settings.json, .codex/config.toml and hooks.json, .github/hooks and copilot settings, .env, registry settings (.npmrc, .yarnrc(.yml), bunfig.toml, uv.toml, pyproject.toml), CLAUDE.md, CLAUDE.local.md, AGENTS.md, GEMINI.md, .cursorrules, rules, agents, commands and skills folders including .github/agents and .agents/skills, with their frontmatter; symlinks read at their target) and runs nothing. It finds tasks and hooks that download and run code when the folder opens, hooks, skills and MCP servers that do the same (inline servers in agent files included), broad permissions including tools a skill grants itself, acceptEdits mode, plugin marketplaces and plugins the repository turns on, credential helpers and shell prefixes, repository MCP servers enabled without asking, the model API or a proxy pointed at another host (how API keys are taken), the package registry moved elsewhere, CODEX_HOME moved into the repository, invisible Unicode tag characters and bidirectional controls in instruction files, injection and concealment phrases, secrets committed in configs (never echoed); each MCP server goes through install_check. Returns decision allow / hold / block with reasons per file, findings, MCP servers with their verdicts and advice, signed into the public log (kind 4315). Whatever could not be read or checked holds as check_incomplete:<what>, never an allow. Free, no account: one check plus one per MCP server checked; cached 10 minutes.

repo.description: the public GitHub repository: owner/repo or https://github.com/owner/repo (or pass files instead)

ref.description: branch, tag or commit to read; default: the default branch

files.description: instead of repo, for a local or private checkout: the agent configuration files as path from the repository root -> content (only the paths this tool reads, at most 40 files and 2 MB in all). alalanet keeps no content; the public record holds only the decision, the files' sha256 and bare reason codes (no paths, no names); the packages they name are checked without being signed or logged; remote servers are looked up, never probed; from .env only CODEX_HOME, model-API, proxy and preload variables are read

annotations.title: Check a service before paying or connecting

tools.description: Call before the first payment to an x402 endpoint, before connecting to an MCP server, and whenever a call to it fails. Give url (any https URL, listed or not: unknown URLs are probed now and detected as x402 or MCP) or id from find_service. Returns: alive, advice (ok / ok_requires_auth: working as listed; ok_terms_not_checked and unverified_yet: not fully checked yet; caution_*: a change worth confirming with the user — pay_to_changed, network_changed, price_higher_than_listed, high_price, tools_changed, suspicious_tool_description, buyers_report_failures; avoid_*: alalanet found a blocking problem — down, not_working_as_listed, sanctioned_pay_to, pay_to_frozen), trust_score (0-100, open formula at /trust) with flags, checked_at and last_alive_at (when it last answered as listed, so a dead answer says how long it has been gone), observed price, network and pay_to versus the catalogue listing, uptime 24h/7d/30d, host_listings and pay_to_shared_by_hosts, verified purchases, alalanet's own test purchase, for MCP the tool-set diff (tools_diff, tool_description_flags), and when the advice is caution_* or avoid_*, up to 3 working alternatives on other hosts. Default answers from recent checks (free tier: 100 a day); live=true probes now and adds a signed, logged attestation you can keep as evidence (5 live checks a day free). Read-only for the caller; an unknown URL joins the public catalogue. preflight_payment gives the decision for one specific 402. Docs: https://alalanet.com/skill.md.

id.description: service id from find_service results; give either id or url

url.description: https URL of the x402 endpoint or MCP server to check; any public URL works, unknown ones are probed and added (private, loopback, link-local and cloud-metadata addresses are refused by an SSRF guard)

live.description: true probes the service now and returns a signed, logged receipt; false (default) answers from recent checks

tools.name: check_service
tools.title: Check a service before paying or connecting

tools.description: Use when you need a paid API or MCP server for a task, or a working alternative after a call failed. Pass query in plain words (e.g. weather forecast, web search, image generation); optional protocol (x402 or mcp), only_alive (default true) and limit (1-25, default 10). Read-only; free tier 300 searches a day. Returns services ranked by the open Trust Score (/trust), at most 2 per host unless your query names the host: each with status, advice, trust_score, live price and network, pay_to, pay_to_shared_by_hosts (many hosts on one payTo = a platform wallet), host_listings, uptime and an id that check_service and preflight_payment accept.

query.description: what you need, in plain words (e.g. weather forecast, web search, image generation)

protocol.description: filter by protocol: x402 (pay per call) or mcp (remote MCP server); empty means both

only_alive.description: return only services that work as listed right now (default true)

annotations.title: Is it safe to install this package, repo, skill or MCP server?

tools.description: Checks something before it is installed, typically when a README, a document or another agent suggests installing it: an npm or PyPI package, an install command (npx -y pkg, uvx pkg, pip install pkg, npm i pkg, claude mcp add NAME -- npx -y pkg, skills add owner/repo, clawhub install slug, code --install-extension publisher.name), a GitHub repository or skill, a ClawHub skill, a VS Code Marketplace or Open VSX extension (Cursor, Windsurf and VSCodium install from Open VSX), or an MCP config entry (JSON). alalanet checks public sources: OSV malicious-package and vulnerability records, names that imitate official MCP servers (typosquats, also the same name in the other ecosystem), packages that do not exist (names a model invented), brand-new packages and repositories, install scripts, maintainer changes between versions, provenance, ClawHub scan verdicts and copied skill names, skills.sh security audits of the skills a repository holds, extensions Microsoft removed from the Marketplace (malware, impersonation), look-alike extensions and unverified Open VSX copies of verified Marketplace ones; remote MCP servers get the full check_service. Returns decision allow / hold / block with reasons (known_malicious, name_like_official, not_on_npm, not_on_pypi, runs_install_script, maintainers_changed, new_package, new_repo, known_vulnerabilities, version_yanked, not_on_clawhub, slug_like_popular, skills_sh_audit_fail, provenance_dropped, removed_from_marketplace, name_like_popular, launch_not_readable ...), facts and advice, signed into the public log (kind 4310). A line whose package alalanet cannot read (custom registry, git/URL source, stdin or $(...) arguments, several packages, other commands) holds. allow means no known problem was found, not that the code was read. Free, no account.

target.description: what you are about to install, in any common form: an npm or PyPI package (name, name@1.2.3, npm:name, pypi:name==1.2), an install command (npx -y pkg, uvx pkg, pip install pkg, npm i pkg, claude mcp add NAME -- npx -y pkg, skills add owner/repo (also owner/repo@skill, owner/repo@v1.2.3 or #ref pins, owner/repo/sub/folder, -s skill …), clawhub install slug or @owner/slug, code or cursor --install-extension publisher.name), a GitHub repository URL, a VS Code Marketplace or Open VSX extension page, or an MCP config entry as JSON ({"command":"npx","args":["-y","pkg"]} or {"url": <remote MCP URL>})

annotations.title: Did my x402 payment settle? May I pay again?

tools.description: Tells whether an x402 payment settled, for use after a timeout, a 5xx or any unclear answer to a paid request and before a new payment is signed. Pass network and the settlement tx, or (EVM exact) from + nonce + valid_before of the signed authorization, or (Solana exact) from + the recentBlockhash of the signed transaction; the signature itself is not needed. safe_to_sign_new is true only when a new payment cannot pay twice. alalanet reads the chain and answers state (settled | pending | not_settled | expired_unsettled | failed) and retry: do_not_pay_again, resend_same (same authorization can settle only once), new_payment_ok, or wait. Prevents paying twice. Read-only (nothing is signed or logged); the error chain_unavailable means the payment networks did not answer, and the same question can be asked again after 15 s.

network.description: Base: eip155:8453 or base; Solana: solana or solana:5eykt4UsFv8P8NJdTREpY1vzqKqZKvdp

tx.description: settlement transaction hash from the transaction field of the PAYMENT-RESPONSE header (0x + 64 hex on Base, base58 signature on Solana), if you got one

from.description: payments without a tx: EVM exact: payload.authorization.from of the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE you sent (your wallet address); Solana exact: your wallet address (the signer of the transaction besides the facilitator's fee payer)

nonce.description: EVM exact payments without a tx: payload.authorization.nonce of the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE you sent (0x + 64 hex); never send the signature itself

valid_before.description: payload.authorization.validBefore (unix seconds): lets alalanet tell an expired, unused authorization (safe to pay anew) from one that may still settle

asset.description: token contract; default USDC on Base

blockhash.description: Solana exact payments without a tx: the recentBlockhash of the transaction you signed (base58); with from it identifies your payment, since the facilitator's fee-payer signature (the transaction id) is unknown to you before settlement

annotations.title: Decide before paying an x402 endpoint

tools.description: Decision for one x402 payment, made right before it is signed. Pass the endpoint url and the 402 it returned (PAYMENT-REQUIRED header value or JSON body), optionally max_usd. Optional client: the x402 library and version (e.g. @x402/fetch@2.22.1): known payment flaws come back in client_advisories (not logged). Each payment option gets allow / hold / block with reasons: block: pay_to_unknown, pay_to_sanctioned, pay_to_frozen_by_issuer, service_not_working, over_budget; hold: pay_to_differs_from_listing, pay_to_never_seen, price_above_listing, price_above_observed, network_not_listed, asset_not_stablecoin, high_price, unknown_service, not_checked_yet, not_rated_yet, low_trust_score; info: pay_to_as_observed, pay_to_platform_wallet, amount_is_ceiling (scheme upto), frozen_status_unknown, testnet. The decision is signed, bound to the payment hash, logged, and valid for 5 minutes. allow: no problem found; hold: something the user should confirm; block: a problem that should stop the payment. Docs: https://alalanet.com/skill.md.

url.description: https URL of the x402 endpoint you are about to pay

payment_required.description: the 402 the endpoint returned: x402 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header value (base64) or JSON body, or an MPP WWW-Authenticate: Payment value; omit to judge the terms alalanet last observed

max_usd.description: your budget for this one call in US dollars; options above it are blocked

client.description: optional: your x402 client library and version, e.g. @x402/fetch@2.22.1 or pypi:x402@2.19.0; alalanet warns about versions with known payment flaws (not logged)

tools.name: preflight_payment
tools.title: Decide before paying an x402 endpoint

annotations.title: Report what you got after paying

tools.description: After you paid an x402 endpoint on Base or Solana (network eip155:8453, base, solana or solana:5eykt4UsFv8P8NJdTREpY1vzqKqZKvdp): report the outcome (delivered, partial, wrong_content, not_delivered) with the payment tx hash (the transaction field of the PAYMENT-RESPONSE header). No key needed: alalanet verifies on chain that the tx paid this service's known payTo in USDC/USDT within 7 days, signs the report into the public log, one report per payment. Deliveries from different paying wallets raise the seller's Trust Score; failures trigger an immediate recheck. This is how agents learn which sellers deliver.

service_url.description: https URL of the x402 endpoint you paid

tx.description: payment transaction hash (PAYMENT-RESPONSE header transaction, or your wallet)

preflight_id.description: id of the preflight attestation you got before paying, if any

result_sha256.description: sha256 hex of the response you received

annotations.title: Are these the tools this MCP server really serves?

tools.description: Checks the tools an agent received from a remote MCP server against alalanet's history of that server, to catch a server that changed its tools after you approved them, or serves you something different from what it serves everyone else. Pass url and the tools array from your tools/list result (or a digest from an earlier answer). Read-only and free. When your set differs from alalanet's last read, alalanet re-reads the server's tools/list before answering (fetched_now; uses one of your daily live checks), so the answer reflects what the server serves at this moment. Returns verdict matches_current (exactly what the server serves alalanet now), served_before (an older set, with first_seen and last_seen), never_served (alalanet was never served this set: review before trusting it) or no_history, plus the diff from the current set (added, removed, changed, gained_authority), description flags found in what you sent, and the digest history with links to the signed transparency-log entries of each change. Names and descriptions are third-party text.

url.description: https URL of the remote MCP server, exactly as you connect to it

tools.description: the tools array from the tools/list result you received

digest.description: alternatively an alalanet tool-set digest (64 hex) from an earlier answer
